summary: C# consistency cleanup from a full-repo audit: rename CheckFirstActionRestriction to ValidateFirstActionRestriction (matches Validate*/Check* convention); add deterministic OrderBy(Id) to previously-unordered player-facing ability performer/source candidate lists in CardAbilities.cs (nondeterminism risk for replay/network sync); convert internal fire-and-forget async void methods to async Task with explicit discard at call sites (Main.cs Submit, DeckBuilderScreen.Cards.cs Hover, the Main.*Checks.cs/*Capture.cs dev-capture-harness probe/prepare cluster); thread CancellationToken through RoomManager AttachAsync/SubmitAsync (DetachAsync deliberately keeps CancellationToken.None at its call site since it runs from a finally cleanup block where the request token is typically already canceled); add missing SubmitAsync rejection-branch logging; enable TreatWarningsAsErrors for L5R.Client and L5R.AI to match L5R.Core/L5R.Server. One audited item (ArgumentException usage in CustomPractice.cs/DeckWorkshop.cs/GoldShowcase.cs) was investigated and left unchanged: it is a deliberate, test-asserted exception vocabulary for deck-building/setup code outside MatchEngine's private Require/RuleViolation, not a real inconsistency.
validation: bash tools/check.sh (full, no --skip-client): all four .NET test projects (L5R.Core.Tests, L5R.AI.Tests, L5R.Server.Tests, L5R.Client.Transport.Tests) pass, clean rebuild of L5R.Core/L5R.Client/L5R.Server/L5R.AI with 0 warnings/0 errors including the newly-enabled TreatWarningsAsErrors on Client and AI, Godot headless --import and smoke run report no ERROR/SCRIPT ERROR. remaining: None; ready for review. No rules-visible or UI-visible behavior change intended; the ordering fix changes only the order legal actions are offered/iterated in, not which actions are legal.
